data.name: Jibon
data.gender_notes: Jibon is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jibon is derived from the Sanskrit root 'jiv', meaning 'living being'. This name signifies the essence of life itself. In Hindu mythology, Jibon is believed to be a divine name for the soul or atman. The name Jibon carries the meaning “Lively, Existence” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jibon usually hope their child will grow to embody lively, existence and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Jibon belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lively, Existence.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jibon total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
